description: Turns delivery by email and to Slack on or off. Slack gets the finished cycle, and also the daily digest and each high signal alert when slack_digest and slack_alerts are on. Only the switches you send change. Slack needs Growth or above and a Slack connection made in the app. Channel rules for Slack are set in the app. Admin only.

slack.description: Every Slack post. Off sends nothing to Slack.

slack_alerts.description: Each high signal alert in Slack

name: set_delivery_channels
title: Set delivery channels
